facts.en: Completed a diploma in Accounting Operations at Fictional Academy B15 in 2018.
facts.zh: 2018 年在虚构学院 B15 完成会计运营文凭课程。

facts.en: Invoice clerk at Fictional Supply Cooperative B15, 2018-08 to 2021-12.
facts.zh: 2018-08 至 2021-12，任虚构供应合作社 B15 发票文员。

facts.en: Accounts payable associate at the same fictional cooperative, 2022-01 to 2026-09.
facts.zh: 2022-01 至 2026-09，在同一虚构合作社任应付账款专员。

facts.en: Matched supplier invoices to purchase orders and receipt records before approval routing.
facts.zh: 在提交审批前，将供应商发票与采购订单及收货记录匹配。

facts.en: Processed a median of 85 invoices per month during 2026-01 to 2026-06, measured from an internal register.
facts.zh: 2026-01 至 2026-06，每月处理发票数量的中位数为 85 张，依据内部登记表统计。

facts.en: Maintained an exception queue and requested missing receipt documents from buyers.
facts.zh: 维护异常处理队列，并向采购人员索取缺失收货文件。

facts.en: In 2025-09, built an Excel lookup sheet for invoice reference checks.
facts.zh: 2025-09，制作 Excel 查找表，用于核对发票参考编号。

facts.en: During a 40-invoice trial, the sheet flagged 3 repeated reference numbers for review; no fraud conclusion was made.
facts.zh: 在 40 张发票试用中，该表标出 3 个重复参考编号供复核；未作出欺诈结论。

facts.en: Payment release remained with the finance manager; no payroll processing is recorded.
facts.zh: 付款放行由财务经理负责；未记录薪资处理经历。
